text: POLITICAL SCIENTIST YASCHA MOUNK TAPED JULY 16, 2022 AIRS NOVEMBER ?? 2022 TEASE Yascha Mounk: One of the sort of deep experiences of my childhood was that people could never really look at me as an individual. MARCIA 	COMING UP… A CONVERSATION WITH POLITICAL SCIENTIST YASCHA MOUNK ABOUT IDENTITY, POLITICAL CHOICES, AND THE STATE OF THE UNITED STATES TODAY. 	THAT’S COMING UP ON “CONVERSATIONS FROM THE SUN VALLEY WRITERS’ CONFERENCE.” STAY TUNED. 				(TO OPEN)	 INTRODUCTION	HELLO AND WELCOME TO DIALOGUE. I’M MARCIA FRANKLIN. 	MY GUEST TODAY WAS PART OF A UNIQUE GROUP IN GERMANY WHEN HE WAS GROWING UP – ONE OF ABOUT 30 THOUSAND JEWISH PEOPLE STILL LIVING IN GERMANY POST-WORLD WAR II. 	BECAUSE OF THAT, HE DIDN’T FEEL PARTICULARLY GERMAN. BUT SINCE THERE WERE SO FEW JEWISH PEOPLE AROUND HIM, HE DIDN’T IDENTIFY WITH THAT CULTURE, EITHER. STILL FRAME YASCHA 	YASCHA MOUNK IS NOW AN AMERICAN CITIZEN, AND HIS EARLY EXPERIENCES THINKING ABOUT HIS IDENTITY HELPED FORGE HIS CAREER AND EXPERTISE AS A POLITICAL SCIENTIST. BOOK COVERS 	HE’S THE AUTHOR OF SEVERAL BOOKS, INCLUDING: “THE PEOPLE VS. DEMOCRACY: WHY OUR FREEDOM IS IN DANGER AND HOW TO SAVE IT,” AND “THE GREAT EXPERIMENT: WHY DIVERSE DEMOCRACYES FALL APART AND HOW THEY CAN ENDURE.” HE’S ALSO WRITTEN A MEMOIR CALLED “STRANGER IN MY OWN COUNTRY: A JEWISH FAMILY IN MODERN GERMANY.” LOGO I SPOKE WITH MOUNK AT THE 2022 SUN VALLEY WRITERS’ CONFERENCE.
